Team —

We have one full day before the board packet goes final. Quick sweep to lock the bookings and ARR narrative: I attached the evidence matrix (tab per deal) and a short stage-closure log (stage-closure-notes.md). Please do the following by EOD tomorrow (10/04):

1) For every deal in the green/commit corridor, confirm the close date and attach the last-touch artifact (PO, signed SOW, DocuSign envelope id) in the Drive folder. Add a note in column D of the spreadsheet indicating whether evidence is: PO / SOW / Email confirmation.
2) For deals marked 'at-risk', update the stage to either "Commit - contingent" or revert to "Commit - no evidence" and add a one-line rationale.
3) If you own the renewal/expansion, include the ARR delta and source doc; if it's a motion-owned deal (partner-led), flag that in the 'owner' column.

I've pre-filled the matrix for Stratus (DEAL-1729) but need external confirmation (Emma cc'd on this thread). Ben — please validate the PO number I entered and paste the DocuSign id if available. Vivek — if you see any rounding/ARR definition issues, flag them now; we'll standardize to annualized ARR at net-new subscription value.

Attachments:
- 20271003-bookings-evidence-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 6 tabs)
- stage-closure-notes.md (plain text)
